description:
Keyword-polarity sentiment for a crypto cashtag on X/Twitter. It fetches recent posts for $TOPIC and counts how many contain a positive and how many a negative keyword; the 0-100 score is the positive share of those polar posts. Returns the score, a bullish (70 or more), neutral or bearish (30 or less) label, and the number of posts read. When no post carried a sentiment keyword the score is null and the label is insufficient_signal: report that, not a neutral reading. Always state how many posts the reading was built from. Use it when the user asks about market mood or social sentiment for a token. The call is metered, so ask once per topic and reuse.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
